name: approvals_of_a_run_the_tool_opened
why: The tool opened the run, so no server served its approvals.

name: commit_review_of_a_run_the_tool_opened
why: The tool opened the run, so no server served its commit review.

name: approvals_of_a_run_the_tool_opened_still_in_progress
why: The tool opened the run and left its pre-deploy stage out as needing the server, so no server will ever serve approvals to this run.

name: approvals_a_server_opened_run_needed_and_did_not_get
why: The server opened the run and the pre-deploy stage kept the unknown marker where a check needed its approvals.

name: exceptions_of_a_run_that_relied_on_a_project_exception
why: An event names an exception from the project's own exceptions file; it comes before run_opened_locally.

name: exceptions_of_a_server_opened_run_relying_on_no_exception
why: The server opened the run, its plan stage applied the exceptions the server served, and no failed result relies on one.

name: reference_time_of_a_run_on_the_runners_clock
why: Every stage took its time from the runner's clock, so no trusted time source was used.

name: reference_time_of_a_run_on_the_servers_time
why: Every stage took the time the server gave, the record's own claim.

name: evaluator_binary_of_a_record_on_a_placeholder_binary
why: Its OPA evaluations name a placeholder digest, not the pinned binary for their platform.

name: evaluator_binary_of_a_record_on_the_pinned_binary
why: Every OPA evaluation names the pinned binary for its platform.

name: exceptions_of_a_server_opened_run_whose_environment_policy_left_out_its_pre_deploy_stage
why: The server opened the run and its plan stage applied the exceptions the server served, relying on none; an exception result comes before pre_deploy_out_of_scope.

name: approvals_of_a_server_opened_run_whose_environment_policy_left_out_its_pre_deploy_stage
why: The environment's policy left the pre-deploy stage out of scope, so the record reads no approval.

name: bundle_used_of_a_run_the_tool_opened
why: No stage names the server's bundle: the checks were the project's own.

name: bundle_signature_of_a_run_the_tool_opened

name: bundle_used_of_a_server_opened_run
why: A stage names the server's bundle, and no run statement says the server held the run to it.

name: bundle_signature_of_a_run_the_server_opened_whose_kept_bundles_read_back
why: Every stage that names the server's bundle kept its tarball, which read back under a key of the trust set, its signature verified, and names the trust data the reader holds.

name: exceptions_of_a_server_opened_run_relying_on_an_exception_its_run_starter_approved_with_pre_deploy_pending
why: The plan stage names failed results exceptions the server served cover, and the kept copy says the person who approved one of them started the run. The exception results come before the pre-deploy stage's pending one, so the pending stage does not hide them.

name: scanner_reports_of_a_record_with_no_scanner_report
why: No stage read a scanner report and none requires one.

name: scanner_reports_of_a_record_whose_reports_the_pipeline_ran

name: scanner_reports_of_a_record_whose_required_scanner_group_gave_only_gaps

name: exceptions_of_a_tracked_run_relying_on_no_served_exception

name: exceptions_of_a_tracked_run_relying_on_served_exceptions

name: scanner_reports_of_a_tracked_run_with_no_scanner_report

name: approvals_of_a_tracked_run_the_server_served_an_approval_for

name: commit_review_of_a_tracked_run_whose_commits_were_reviewed

name: approvals_of_a_tracked_run_whose_server_facts_were_unavailable

why: The later apply job compared no re-plan.

name: integrity_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The run statement verified, lists the record as its unit's subject and differs from it in nothing, and every file the record cites holds the digest it names.

name: integrity_of_a_record_the_server_refused
why: The run statement lists the record's digest as a record the server refused.

name: source_identity_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The record's commit and repository are those of the CI job the run statement signs for each stage.

name: source_identity_of_a_record_whose_commit_is_not_its_ci_jobs
why: The run statement signs a CI job of another commit for a stage of the record.

name: approvals_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of its approvals hashes to the digest the run statement signs.

name: approvals_whose_copy_is_not_the_signed_one
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of its approvals is not the one the run statement signs.

name: bundle_signature_of_a_stage_that_checked_other_trust_data
why: The reader also holds an operator's trust file, so the trust data it holds is not the trust data the stages checked their bundle against.

name: bundle_signature_of_a_bundle_another_server_signed
why: The run statement names another server than the one whose key signed the stages' bundle.

name: bundle_used_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The run statement's settings name the bundle every stage of the record names.

name: bundle_used_other_than_the_run_settings
why: The run statement's settings name another bundle than the stages of the record.

name: stage_completeness_of_a_finished_run_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The run statement lists no result left unanswered and no expected stage without an accepted record.

name: stage_completeness_of_a_final_record_missing_a_stage
why: The run statement holds for the record, its unit's subject, which lacks its post-verify stage: the run ended, so the stage will never be reported, and the statement verifies nothing of a stage the record does not hold.

name: stage_completeness_of_a_closed_run_with_a_result_unanswered
why: The run closed, and its statement lists a required result no accepted record answered.

name: stage_completeness_of_a_closed_run_whose_final_record_lacks_a_stage
why: The run closed with an expected stage that accepted no record, and the record, its unit's subject, lacks that stage.

name: stage_completeness_of_other_expected_stages_than_the_run_settings
why: The record's expected stages are not those of the run's settings.

name: stage_completeness_of_other_required_assertions_than_the_run_settings
why: A stage's required assertions are not those of the run's settings.

name: check_after_deployment_of_a_run_that_ended_without_it
why: The run statement says the run ended, and the record, its unit's subject, has no post-verify stage.

name: exceptions_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The plan stage relied on exceptions the server served, and its copy of them hashes to the digest the run statement signs.

name: exceptions_whose_copy_is_not_the_signed_one
why: The plan stage's copy of the exceptions the server served is not the one the run statement signs.

name: commit_review_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The pre-deploy stage kept a reviewed commit review whose copy hashes to the digest the run statement signs.

name: commit_review_whose_copy_is_not_the_signed_one
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of its commit review is not the one the run statement signs.

name: reference_time_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: Every stage took the time the server gave, which the run statement signs as when it issued the stage its facts or its token.

name: reference_time_other_than_the_signed_one
why: A stage took its time from the server, and the run statement says the server issued its facts at another time.

name: plan_age_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of the apply job's facts hashes to the digest the run statement signs, and its times are within the limit.

name: plan_age_whose_facts_are_not_the_signed_ones
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of the apply job's facts is not the one the run statement signs.

name: apply_job_approval_order_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The copies of the apply job's facts and of the approvals hash to the digests the run statement signs, and every approval was received after the plan-stage record.

name: apply_job_approval_order_whose_approvals_are_not_the_signed_ones
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of its approvals is not the one the run statement signs.

name: pinned_plan_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The run statement signs the facts that pin the plan the accepted record names.

name: pinned_plan_whose_facts_are_not_the_signed_ones
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of the apply job's facts is not the one the run statement signs.

name: received_plan_file_whose_facts_are_not_the_signed_ones
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of the apply job's facts is not the one the run statement signs.

name: rendered_plan_whose_facts_are_not_the_signed_ones
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of the apply job's facts is not the one the run statement signs.

name: replan_resource_actions_whose_facts_are_not_the_signed_ones
why: The pre-deploy stage's copy of the apply job's facts is not the one the run statement signs.

name: received_plan_file_of_a_record_its_run_statement_holds_for
why: The run statement signs the facts, but the received plan file's digest is what the apply job reported: it stays the record's claim.

name: stage_completeness_of_an_abandoned_run_with_a_result_unanswered
why: The record reports every stage it expects, and the run was abandoned with a required result no accepted record answered.

name: stage_completeness_of_a_record_a_later_record_replaced
why: The record counts at its last stage, and the run statement names a later record that holds the post-verify stage: the statement verifies nothing of a stage this record does not hold.

name: check_after_deployment_of_a_record_a_later_record_replaced
why: The post-verify stage is held by the later record the run statement names, not by this one.

name: stage_completeness_of_a_stage_the_statement_does_not_list
why: The run statement lists no plan stage for the record's unit.

name: scanner_reports_of_another_served_scanner_check_mapping
why: A stage applied another served scanner check mapping than the run statement's settings.
